#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>
#include <cstdint>
#include <algorithm>

const int BASE = 1 << 15;
const int MOD = 998244353;

std::vector<int> multiplyMod(const std::vector<int>& a, const std::vector<int>& b, int mod) {
    int need = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
    std::vector<long long> c(need, 0);
    // Mask coefficients to low 15 bits and compute convolution
    for (size_t i = 0; i < a.size(); ++i) {
        long long ai = a[i] & 0x7FFF;
        if (ai == 0) continue;
        for (size_t j = 0; j < b.size(); ++j) {
            long long bj = b[j] & 0x7FFF;
            c[i + j] += ai * bj;
        }
    }
    // Normalize with carries, but only keep first 'need' digits
    for (int i = 0; i < need; ++i) {
        long long carry = c[i] / BASE;
        c[i] %= BASE;
        if (i + 1 < need) {
            c[i + 1] += carry;
        }
        // ignore carry beyond need-1
    }
    // Take modulo mod
    std::vector<int> res(need);
    for (int i = 0; i < need; ++i) {
        res[i] = (int)(c[i] % mod);
    }
    return res;
}

int nextInt() {
    int c = getchar();
    while (c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t') c = getchar();
    int sign = 1;
    if (c == '-') {
        sign = -1;
        c = getchar();
    }
    int res = 0;
    while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
        res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
        c = getchar();
    }
    return res * sign;
}

int main() {
    int n = nextInt();
    int k = nextInt();
    std::vector<int> v(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        int x = nextInt();
        v[x] = 1;
    }
    std::vector<int> ans = {1};
    int p = n / 2;
    while (true) {
        if (p % 2 != 0) {
            ans = multiplyMod(ans, v, MOD);
        }
        p /= 2;
        if (p == 0) break;
        v = multiplyMod(v, v, MOD);
    }
    long long res = 0;
    for (int x : ans) {
        res = (res + (long long)x * x) % MOD;
    }
    printf("%lld\n", res);
    return 0;
}
